content:
You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
This is a game of Werewolf with 5 players: 1 Seer, 1 Werewolf, 1 Possessed, and 2 Villagers. Participants: Toshio, George, Sakura, Victoria and Kenji. Each player's role is secret.
- Seer: a human who divines one player each night and learns whether that player is human or a werewolf.
- Werewolf: attacks one player each night from day 1 on.
- Possessed: a human who sides with the werewolf and wins when the werewolf wins; divination shows the Possessed as human.
- Villager: a human with no special ability.

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in days. Each day has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Kenji, Victoria, Toshio, George and Sakura. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this day). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Day | Start of the day | Talk | End of the day | Night |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | nothing | 4 turns | no vote | the Seer divines one other living player; no attack |
| 1 | the Seer is told the result of the night-0 divination (the Seer only) | 4 turns | every living player votes; the player with the most votes is executed | the Seer divines one other living player; the Werewolf attacks one other living player |
| 2 and after | everyone is told who was executed, who was attacked and all the votes of the previous day; the Seer is told the result of the previous night's divination (the Seer only) | 4 turns | vote and execution as on day 1 | divination and attack as on day 1 |
- A divination tells whether the chosen player is human or a werewolf. If the Seer is dead, there is no divination.
- Executed and attacked players are dead from the next day on.
A player may vote for themselves. If votes are tied, one of the tied players is chosen by a fixed rule. The village wins when the werewolf is executed. The werewolf wins when the number of werewolves is at least the number of living humans. The game ends as soon as one side has won.

## Night actions
At night, the Seer chooses one other living player to divine. From day 1 on, the werewolf chooses one other living player to attack.

## Participants
Name: Toshio
Age: 28
Gender: male
Personality: Toshio has a calm and calculating personality and does not often show his emotions. He has a strong will and is the type of person who steadily moves toward his goals. He tends to take a step back from those around him, is not very assertive, and has an air of mystery about him. Occasionally, he observes things with a sharp gaze and has the ability to quickly assess situations. As a result, he is trusted by others as a reliable presence, but he is cautious about getting deeply involved with others. It seems that he has experienced some pain or suffering in his past, but he rarely shows it to others, and those scars may be connected to his cold-hearted side.
Role: Villager

Name: George
Age: 65
Gender: male
Personality: George has a gentle and calm personality, but he can also be a little stubborn and headstrong at times. He is seen by those around him as a reliable person with a wealth of experience appropriate for his age, and he is always able to make calm judgments, allowing him to handle difficult situations without panicking. However, his expressions sometimes reveal a hint of sternness or awkwardness, and he tends to observe things from a step back rather than actively engaging with others. He is very independent and tends to try to solve problems on his own without relying on others.
Role: Possessed

Name: Sakura
Age: 10
Gender: female
Personality: Sakura is a cheerful girl with a slightly mischievous personality. She is very curious and actively takes on new challenges with enthusiasm. She is good at making people laugh with her pranks and solving little mysteries. She is friendly and gets along well with everyone, so she is good at making friends with those around her. However, she also has a slightly clumsy side, but she has a positive personality that allows her to overcome failures with a smile.
Role: Werewolf

Name: Victoria
Age: 37
Gender: female
Personality: Victoria is a calm and rational person, but at times her excessive thoughtfulness can create barriers between her and those around her. She is reserved in her emotional expressions and keenly observes the expressions and attitudes of others, trying to discern their inner thoughts. Because she does not express herself much, she often gives others the impression of being somewhat mysterious, but deep down she has a strong will and a determination to stick to her beliefs. At times, she may display expressions of anxiety or fear, but it is precisely in such moments that her true strength becomes evident.
Role: Seer

Name: Kenji
Age: 12
Gender: male
Personality: Kenji is curious and actively takes on challenges. He values his friends and enjoys communicating with those around him. Although he can be a little clumsy at times, he is always positive and never abandons those in need. He is easygoing and well-liked by those around him.
Role: Villager

## Plan
The discussion follows this plan.
- Day 0: The participants introduce themselves and discuss their general strategies for the game. They weigh the importance of trust versus skepticism in the early stages.
- Day 1: The group discusses the information available and looks for discrepancies in behavior. They debate the validity of certain assertions and try to identify the most suspicious person.

Each participant's part:
- Toshio: He focuses on logical inconsistencies and observes behavioral patterns. He remains cautious and only commits to a decision when the evidence seems overwhelming.
- George: He relies on his experience to judge character. He tries to maintain stability and avoid hasty decisions, though he can be stubborn once he forms an opinion.
- Sakura: She uses a playful and energetic tone to deflect attention. She tries to steer the conversation toward others by asking many questions.
- Victoria: She analyzes the emotional state of others and looks for contradictions. She carefully chooses when to share her information to maximize its impact.
- Kenji: He is open and trusting, often following the lead of those he perceives as more experienced. He speaks honestly about his feelings.

Write the complete transcript of the discussion in the exact Markdown format specified. Output only the transcript.

## Output format
Markdown, exactly this structure; nothing before or after it:

# aiwolf_0027
## Day 0
### Talk
#### Turn 1 of 4
- **<Name>**: <utterance, or exactly Skip, or exactly Over>
(one line per living participant, in the fixed speaking order; repeat for Turn 2, 3 and 4; a participant who said Over has no line in the later turns of that day)
### Action
- divine: <Seer's name> -> <target name> (human|werewolf)
## Day 1
### Talk
(4 turns as above)
### Vote
- <voter name> -> <target name>
(one line per living participant)
- execution: <name of the player with the most votes>
### Action
- divine: <Seer's name> -> <target name> (human|werewolf)
- attack: <Werewolf's name> -> <target name>
(continue with ## Day 2 and so on in the same way until the game ends)
## Result
- winner: village|werewolves

Constraints on the content: dead players have no further lines. The divine result must match the target's true role. Write ## Result right after the deciding Vote or Action and nothing else.
